result.topic_en: Euler completes the argument that every prime divisor of a number of the form pp+2qq must itself be of the form xx+2yy, by showing that such a number cannot have a divisor not of that form, through a descent on the smallest such divisor.
result.transcription:
Tractatus de numerorum doctrina Cap. 16. 75
586. Hinc autem nondum concludi potest, si unus factor, etiamsi sit compositus, ipsius
$pp+2qq$ fuerit formae $xx+2yy$, etiam alterum fore hujus formae. Demonstrandum restat nu-
merum $pp+2qq$ non esse posse formae vel $\mathfrak{AB}$, vel $A\mathfrak{AB}$, vel $AB\mathfrak{AB}$, quod si esset, foret
utique $\mathfrak{AB}$ numerus hujus formae.
587. Visuri autem an $pp+2qq$ per numerum $\mathfrak{A}$ non formae $xx+2yy$ dividi queat, quod
si fieri posset, foret $p<\frac{1}{2}\mathfrak{A}$ et $q<\frac{1}{2}\mathfrak{A}$, unde $pp+2qq<\frac{3}{4}\mathfrak{AA}$, quotusque $<\frac{3}{4}\mathfrak{A}$, qui esset vel
ipse numerus non $xx+2yy$, vel factorem talem haberet $\mathfrak{B}$, qui cum etiam factor esset ipsius
$pp+2qq$, minimus talis numerus $\mathfrak{B}$ assignari posset, divisor formae cujuspiam $xx+2yy$, quod
cum fieri nequeat, numeri $pp+2qq$ nullos habent divisores primos, qui non ipsi sint formae
$xx+2yy$.

methods.what: Bounding p and q by half the divisor (reduction modulo the divisor) so that pp+2qq < (3/4)A², hence the quotient is < (3/4)A
Infinite descent: a divisor not of the form xx+2yy would give a smaller one, which is impossible, so all prime divisors of pp+2qq are of the form xx+2yy
methods.quote:
minimus talis numerus $\mathfrak{B}$ assignari posset, divisor formae cujuspiam $xx+2yy$, quod
cum fieri nequeat, numeri $pp+2qq$ nullos habent divisores primos, qui non ipsi sint formae
$xx+2yy$

items.quote:
Demonstrandum restat nu-
merum $pp+2qq$ non esse posse formae vel $\mathfrak{AB}$, vel $A\mathfrak{AB}$, vel $AB\mathfrak{AB}$
items.english: It remains to be shown that the number pp+2qq cannot be of the form AB, or A·AB, or AB·AB (where the German letters denote numbers not of the form xx+2yy), for if it were, AB would certainly be a number of this form.

items.quote:
Hinc autem nondum concludi potest, si unus factor, etiamsi sit compositus, ipsius
$pp+2qq$ fuerit formae $xx+2yy$, etiam alterum fore hujus formae.
items.english: From this, however, it cannot yet be concluded that if one factor of pp+2qq, even a composite one, is of the form xx+2yy, the other factor is also of this form.

items.quote:
numeri $pp+2qq$ nullos habent divisores primos, qui non ipsi sint formae
$xx+2yy$
items.english: Numbers pp+2qq have no prime divisors that are not themselves of the form xx+2yy.
